# Web2Go

Web2Go is a digital studio focused on AI website optimization, GEO/LLM readiness, technical SEO, structured data, performance, trust, and conversion-focused website design.

Core services:
- AI website optimization
- GEO and LLM optimization
- Technical SEO
- Structured data and Schema.org JSON-LD
- Website redesign
- Business websites
- Landing pages
- Local SEO
- Performance optimization
- Content architecture
- Booking and lead capture systems
- Analytics and conversion tracking

Positioning:
Web2Go helps make business websites easier for humans, search engines, and AI systems to understand. Web2Go does not guarantee search rankings or AI recommendations.
